{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for the two channels of interest
channel_subset = sales[sales['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search'])]

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
conversion_rates = channel_subset.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract rates
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Compute difference (email - paid_search)
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print results
print(f"Email conversion rate: {email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {paid_search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
